register.labelZh: HELP 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: help out 可用來談論協助工作、解決問題、籌備活動或分擔費用。；help somebody on/off with something 可用於外套、夾克、靴子、手套和其他衣物。；help somebody to something 和 help yourself to something 常用於用餐、派對和家庭聚會。；help something along 可表示令談話、課堂、計劃或其他活動進行得更順利。
register.summaryEn: Help out allows you to talk naturally about helping with work, problems, events or costs. Help somebody on/off with something is useful when helping with coats, jackets, boots, gloves and other clothes. Help somebody to something and help yourself to something are useful at meals, parties and family gatherings. Help something along can describe making a conversation, lesson, project or other activity progress more smoothly.
